The '''Ministry of Commerce''' was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic General Ministry|General Ministry]] responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of commerce within the New Republic and kept track of important inter-[[Star system/Legends|system]] shipping.
